data.label: Walkthrough 1 (start: Student - opens an exam): Route 53 > CloudFront > WAF > API Gateway (JWT) > exam Lambda in AZ-A or AZ-B > gateway endpoint > DynamoDB

Walkthrough 2 (start: Student - uploads): steps 1-2 (POST /upload-url) use the walkthrough 1 path to the Exam API Lambda, which returns the presigned POST; then upload straight to S3 > ObjectCreated > SQS > notifier in AZ-A or AZ-B > interface endpoint > SNS > tutor email
AZ failure: fail AZ-A - its NAT gateway, Lambda ENIs and interface-endpoint ENIs go down; API Gateway and SQS deliver to AZ-B; gateway endpoints, DynamoDB, S3, SQS and SNS are regional and unaffected

Circles = simulator hop order. Not drawn as links (no request hop): Cognito (browser sign-in), Scheduler, SES, KMS, Backup, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, CloudFormation - placed in their tier with configuration
presigned POST, 40 MB, direct to S3
